claims.statement: Denver Ed Smith was at Tom Allen's place in St. Louis on the morning of 1897-06-14, where he shook hands with Allen and had breakfast.
claims.excerpt: After shaking hands with Allen, the ex-heavy weight world’s champion, and getting breakfast, Smith went to bed.

claims.statement: Denver Ed Smith and Ike Weir had taken up quarters at Tom Allen's place while looking for fights.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen’s place, where they have taken up quarters

claims.statement: Ike Weir, the Belfast Spider, was also staying at Tom Allen's place.
claims.excerpt: The Spider is also staying at Tom Allen’s place,

claims.statement: Pat Smith, brother of Denver Ed Smith, came from Chicago and also put up at Tom Allen's place.
claims.excerpt: came over from Chicago, also putting up at Tom Allen’s.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he would back Denver Ed Smith if Smith could get a fight with any of the big heavyweights.
claims.excerpt: the latter will back him if he can get a scrap on with any of the big fellows.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was the ex-heavyweight world's champion.

notes: Smith's training plans, Hot Springs trip and Ike Weir's match with Charley Daly are not about Allen; left out. The 'training in St. Louis' point is in article 174 instead.
